2907-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Scute Swarm triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

240-4927-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2364-4761.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-8174.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

222-527-3899-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-6791.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2511-5170-6132-7918.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2946-3967-4871-6887.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3967-4871-6887.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5256-5542-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5256-5542-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3276-5038-5686-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat as needed.

2034-2267-6718-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2267-6718-7654.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

430-2743-7343.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-7343.description:
Cast Mutagen Man by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Mutagen Man enters, it triggers, creating three token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

457-1792-3375-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-3375-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to The Immortal Sun.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3478-3875-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3478-3875-4231-6441.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

225-774-5033.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
225-774-5033.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Storm Cauldron triggers twice, returning both lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 for the other trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

1402-2644-4460-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1496-2034-2919-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-2034-2919-3490.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

889-1387-1500-2100-6898.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Electro, Blood Funnel and Deekah trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Deekah trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

1365-1651-5226-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-5226-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

184-2500-4682.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents which are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-2500-4682.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Smothering Tithe until end of turn.
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe and Mirage Mirror trigger for each opponent you have, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1429-2981-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2981-5402-5929.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2060-2744-3327-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2060-2744-3327-3967.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2082-4050-5189.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to a creature you control.
2082-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2082-4050-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Repeat.

3129-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

413-5663--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-5663--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the persist creature's fabricate trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2452-4050-4484.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
2452-4050-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

526-1692-4200.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Icewind Stalwart.
You control at least one nontoken non-Warrior creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1692-4200.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Icewind Stalwart with haste.
When the Icewind Stalwart token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Warrior you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Icewind Stalwart token.
Repeat from step 2.

250-1525-4930.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand greater than your maximum hand size.
250-1525-4930.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, and putting the land card into your hand due to Abundance.
After all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2 until there are no land cards remaining in your library.
Activate Goblin Charbelcher by paying {3} and tapping it, causing you to reveal your entire library and deal damage equal to your deck size to any target.
You may also repeat step 5 during each of your following turns, as mana permits.

500-1878-4867.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least four cards in hand.
500-1878-4867.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instand and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Jeska's Will and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-2803-3398.notablePrerequisites:
Mark of Sakiko attached to a creature with power seven or greater that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1283-2803-3398.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached as attackers.
Hellkite Charge triggers, causing you to pay {7} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Mark of Sakiko attached.
The creature triggers, adding at least {7}.
Repeat each combat phase.
If the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached has power eight or greater, this combo will net infinite mana.

2452-3882-5113-5220.description:
Cast Silumgar Scavenger either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
When Silumgar Scavenger enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Silumgar Scavenger dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2757-4687-4878.notablePrerequisites: Market Festival attached to a basic land you control.
2757-4687-4878.description:
Activate the basic land with Market Festival attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {1}{G/U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic land.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1993-5033.easyPrerequisites:
You control eight or fewer lands.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-1993-5033.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from your battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2378-2743.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
No opponent controls four or more creatures.
2378-2743.description:
Cast Mirrorweave by paying {2}{W/U}{W/U}, causing each creature to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.
